rows.grounds: compound trailokya-vartin, locating objects within the three worlds
inclusive particle extending scope without exception
universal quantifier applying to every member of the set
things or entities present in experience
past participle of gam, indicating pervasion or presence
compound śiva-rūpa, the essential form or nature of Śiva

items.question: How universally is Śiva's nature present within all objects of the three worlds?
premises: Objects abide throughout the three worlds.
Every object without exception is included.
Śiva's nature is present in those objects.
items.inference: Therefore, Śiva's nature pervades all objects throughout the three worlds without exception.
uncertainties: gataṃ may emphasize arrival, pervasion, or realized presence depending on context.
items.plain_english: Indeed, in all objects abiding in the three worlds, the nature of Śiva is present.
